direction_decision.rationale: DAAD-X is the only remaining candidate that could add independent-population evidence, and its integrity/source-leakage preflight can remain free of ARSC model outcomes. Candidate A has bounded non-tautological value but is necessarily post-result exploratory on the already-viewed Round10 population.

required_before_acceptance: two independent sequential SHA256 reads match
member header checksums and canonical path safety pass
download_binding.permitted_claim_if_archive_passes: local archive is byte-bound and structurally intact; no claim of equality to an unavailable author-published checksum

grouping_inputs_allowed: non-label time and multiview synchronization metadata
deterministically decoded pixels for integrity and duplicate detection
frozen BDD-OIA image inputs for cross-dataset overlap detection
result_blind_firewall.label_snapshot_reality: The scout already inspected aggregate label composition; the auditable blind claim is that media inclusion, grouping, split reconstruction, and duplicate thresholds do not consume label values or model outcomes.
official_loader_reason: dataset construction silently includes rows only when road media exists
decode failure advances to another dataset index rather than preserving an explicit UUID failure

frozen_population.eligible_uuid_source: unique union of current official train.csv, val.csv, and test.csv
frozen_population.other_views_use: source/session provenance and synchronization audit only; no model-input authorization

source_group_reconstruction.independent_unit: highest auditable raw recording or capture session producing one or more clips
source_group_reconstruction.graph_nodes: all 1566 eligible UUIDs before official split overlay
source_group_reconstruction.group_rule: connected components of the union of frozen source and content edges
edge_priority: auditable non-label raw-recording token or complete acquisition-time plus camera-rig/multiview synchronization provenance
byte-exact, decode-exact, broad near-overlap, or broad boundary-continuation evidence used only for conservative merging

near_duplicate_protocol.phash: 64-bit DCT pHash from 32x32 DCT top-left 8x8 excluding DC, thresholded at the remaining-coefficient median

cross_dataset_scan.action_on_match: quarantine the entire DAAD-X source group, never only the matched clip

split_policy.if_official_group_overlap: discard published membership and use exactly one deterministic group-hash split
split_policy.canonical_group_id: SHA256 of sorted group UUID list

gates.name: transport_archive
gates.pass: exact bytes, double-read SHA match, gzip/tar/header/path checks all pass
gates.failure: STOP after at most one official resumable re-fetch attempt

gates.name: frozen_population_binding
gates.pass: 1566 unique official split UUIDs and 1566/1566 unique front-view bindings
gates.failure: STOP on count discrepancy, missing, substitution, or ambiguous binding

gates.name: full_decode
gates.pass: 1566/1566 front videos fully decode with valid metadata
gates.failure: STOP on any empty, truncated, undecodable, or substituted item

gates.name: source_provenance
gates.pass: 100 percent authoritative or auditable non-label raw-source/session provenance
gates.failure: STOP if only UUID/pixels remain or biometric identification would be required

gates.name: grouping_reproducibility
gates.pass: two byte-identical broad-graph runs and 50/50 positive-control recovery
gates.failure: STOP or independent implementation correction review; never tune on real pair results

gates.name: cross_dataset_independence
gates.pass: all BDD-OIA-matched source groups quarantined and later gates still pass
gates.failure: STOP if matched groups remain or quarantine makes later gates fail

gates.name: split_independence
gates.pass: zero source-group intersection after official or one-salt grouped split
gates.failure: STOP on any cross-split group or outcome-informed repair

gates.name: cluster_adequacy
gates.pass: at least 30 groups per split, at least 100 test clips, and max test group share at most 0.10

gates.name: artifact_closure
gates.pass: all required artifacts hash-close with unique successful exit and no unexplained staging or silent exclusions

allowed_preflight_actions: hash and structurally inventory the archive
deterministically probe and fully decode eligible front videos
seal labels and expose UUID/split only to grouping
reconstruct auditable source groups without labels or model outputs
run frozen exact and perceptual duplicate checks
run DAAD-X to BDD-OIA input overlap checks
construct a single deterministic group split if the official split leaks
write the frozen preflight artifact set
prohibited_before_new_independent_go: ARSC metric calculation on DAAD-X model outputs

claim_boundary.preflight_pass_supports_only: Structural audit of package completeness, decodability, source provenance, near-duplicate/cross-dataset overlap, and group-disjoint split feasibility on the frozen DAAD-X snapshot.
does_not_support: construct equivalence between DAAD-X and BDD-OIA
equivalence of 7 mutually exclusive maneuvers to 4 multilabel actions
equivalence of native 17 rationale classes to BDD-OIA 21 classes
natural weather severity or natural corruption dose response
driver independence merely from absence of detected near duplicates
future_adjacent_construct_limits: use any 21-class semantic crosswalk descriptively only
call brightness, blur, and noise synthetic pixel corruptions
claim_boundary.redistribution: publish code, hashes, redacted manifests, and derived statistics only; do not redistribute videos, frames, raw sensitive source identifiers, faces, or reversible fingerprints
